title: Jeff's Place
description:
My home in East Nashville. Recently remodeled, maintaining older charm of neighborhood with all modern conveniences. 4 bedrooms 3 full baths. Close to all things East Nashville, near 5 Points. Quick taxi/UBER ride 2 miles to Broadway! Parking is great here in gated back yard

The space
This is my home in East Nashville. Recently remodeled older home with character. 4 bedrooms 3 full baths. Newly renovated 2 story home in East Nashville. While this home retains its charm, it is also equipped with all the modern amenities, including hardwood floors, central heating/air, new bathrooms, and a new kitchen. With a patio and grill out back, fenced and gated backyard, this house is perfect for a group up to 8, family reunions, leisure travelers,  business travelers & girls/guys weekends! The main level features two queen bedrooms, both beautifully furnished with queen beds and one bath between them. The kitchen is fully equipped with stainless steel appliances, a coffee maker, and plenty of counter space. There is a dining room with a large counter height table, great for meals, games and conversation. Off the kitchen is a large laundry room with a washer, dryer, iron, and ironing board for your convenience. Upstairs has two spacious bedrooms with king beds in each and two newly renovated bathrooms.
Parking is great! Parking is free! Gated back yard.

Guest access
The entire property is yours during your stay. Plenty of parking. May park directly in front of the house on the street or gated back yard has  parking area. Always latch both latches, so that the gate doesn't swing in the wind.

Other things to note
This home is located in East Nashville in the Maxwell neighborhood, just minutes from  local restaurants. Downtown is only 2 miles away (a $5-10 Uber/Lyft trip) and you can walk to great restaurants from the house. 
 Food:  Hunter Station,  Butcher & Bee, Edley's BBQ, The Pharmacy, Margot Cafe & Bar, Nobles Kitchen and Beer Hall, Lyra, Shepi Deli, Snooze AM, Joyland, Cilantro, 5 Points Pizza

 And with downtown only a 2 mile cab/UBER/Lyft, there are so many restaurants, bars, and honky-tonks to explore!
